title: A map of fixed associated sheaves from chart data
statement: Let $k$ be a field, $S=k[T_0,T_1]$ with its standard total-degree grading, and $P=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Let $M,N$ be $S$-modules and $\mathcal M_j\subset M$, $\mathcal N_j\subset N$ additive subgroups indexed by $j\in\mathbf Z$. Let $F,G$ be $\mathcal O_P$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For each positive-degree homogeneous $f\in S_d$, assume additive injective maps $\alpha_f:F(D_+(f))\to M_f$ and $\beta_f:G(D_+(f))\to N_f$ whose ranges are exactly the equal-degree fractions [def-sc-degree-zero-module-fractions] for the respective subgroups. Assume both maps respect the action of $S_{(f)}$ via the canonical standard-open ring map. Assume their restrictions for $D_+(g)\subset D_+(f)$ satisfy $y/f^m\mapsto a^my/g^{em}$ whenever $g^e=af$, $e>0$, and $a$ is homogeneous. If $\phi:M\to N$ is $S$-linear and $\phi(\mathcal M_j)\subset\mathcal N_j$ for every $j$, there exists a sheaf map $\gamma:F\to G$ satisfying $\beta_f(\gamma_f(s))=\phi(y)/f^m$ whenever $\alpha_f(s)=y/f^m$. No internality or scalar-compatibility condition on the indexed subgroups is required beyond the explicit chart hypotheses.

proof.text: Localize phi with IsLocalizedModule.map. Its map_LocalizedModules fraction formula shows preservation of equal-degree fractions, because phi preserves the indexed numerator subgroups. The range equality for beta then chooses the chart map on sections; injectivity of beta proves additivity. ExtendScalarsOfIsLocalization (equivalently the compatible-scalar instance from Mathlib.RingTheory.Localization.Module) shows localization linearity. The two scalar equations and Proj.basicOpenIsoAway give linearity over all ring sections. These are direct transport calculations, carried out in Lean.

For a standard-open inclusion use standardOpenProperties to choose g^e=af. Represent every localized source element as y/f^m by LocalizedModule.induction_on and membership of the powers submonoid. The two supplied restriction formulas and phi.map_smul show compatibility of the chart maps.

Apply the Mathlib basis morphism equivalence restrictHomEquivHom and extend_hom_app to the underlying abelian presheaves. For global linearity, restrict a section to basis opens contained in its domain. Naturality and local linearity give the scalar equality on those opens; their union is the domain and sheaf separation proves it globally. Package the resulting abelian map with PresheafOfModules.homMk. Its basis components give the required fraction formula.

lean.statement:
theorem fixed_chart_map (k : Type u) [Field k]
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))
    (𝓜 : ℤ → AddSubgroup M)
    (F : (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Modules)
    (alpha : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ),
      0 < d → f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d →
      F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)) →+
        LocalizedModule.Away f M)
    (halpha : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d),
        Function.Injective (alpha f d hd hf) ∧
        Set.range (alpha f d hd hf) = degreeZeroFractions
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝓜 n : Set M)) (Submonoid.powers f))
    (hscalar : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (r : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (s : F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
        alpha f d hd hf (awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f r • s) =
          algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
            (Localization.Away f) r • alpha f d hd hf s)
    (hres : ∀ (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d b : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hb : 0 < b)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (hg : g ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k b)
        (inc : basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) g ≤
          basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (e c : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
        0 < e → a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k c → g ^ e = a * f →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : M)
          (s : F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
          alpha f d hd hf s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
          alpha g b hb hg (F.val.map (homOfLE inc).op s) =
            mk (a ^ m • y) (⟨g ^ (e * m), ⟨e * m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers g))
    (N : ModuleCat.{u} (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k))
    (𝓝 : ℤ → AddSubgroup N)
    (G : (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k)).Modules)
    (beta : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ),
      0 < d → f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d →
      G.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)) →+
        LocalizedModule.Away f N)
    (hbeta : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d),
        Function.Injective (beta f d hd hf) ∧
        Set.range (beta f d hd hf) = degreeZeroFractions
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k n : Set (MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k)))
          (fun n : ℕ ↦ (𝓝 n : Set N)) (Submonoid.powers f))
    (hbetascalar : ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (r : HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (s : G.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
        beta f d hd hf (awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f r • s) =
          algebraMap (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
            (Localization.Away f) r • beta f d hd hf s)
    (hbetares : ∀ (f g : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d b : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hb : 0 < b)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d)
        (hg : g ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k b)
        (inc : basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) g ≤
          basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)
        (e c : ℕ) (a : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k),
        0 < e → a ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k c → g ^ e = a * f →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (y : N)
          (s : G.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
          beta f d hd hf s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
          beta g b hb hg (G.val.map (homOfLE inc).op s) =
            mk (a ^ m • y) (⟨g ^ (e * m), ⟨e * m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers g))
    (phi : M →ₗ[MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k] N)
    (hphi : ∀ (z : ℤ) (y : M), y ∈ 𝓜 z → phi y ∈ 𝓝 z) :
    ∃ g : F ⟶ G,
      ∀ (f : MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k) (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d)
        (hf : f ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k d) (m : ℕ) (y : M)
        (s : F.val.obj (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f))),
        alpha f d hd hf s = mk y (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f) →
        beta f d hd hf (g.val.app (op (basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin 2) k) f)) s) =
          mk (phi y) (⟨f ^ m, ⟨m, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f)
